finding.cause: When the CLOEXEC memfd is already descriptor 3, CPython 3.14 os.dup2(fd, fd, inheritable=True) reaches the kernel dup2 identity case, which leaves FD_CLOEXEC set; exec then closes descriptor 3 before the fixed source bootstrap reads it.
finding.reproduction: On ARM64 Linux Python 3.14.7, memfd_create returned 3 with F_GETFD=1; os.dup2(3, 3, inheritable=True) left F_GETFD=1 and get_inheritable(3)=false. The Pi trace does not include memfd allocation order, so occurrence of this exact branch on that target remains unproven.
finding.repair: After optional duplication, explicitly os.set_inheritable(3, True), verify F_GETFD has no FD_CLOEXEC and get_inheritable is true, fstat descriptor 3, and rewind it before exec.
